The diagram above shows a circle of radius $r$ centered at the origin. If the polar coordinates of the point $A$ are $(6, 210^{∘})$ and $m∠AOB = 75^{∘}$, what are the Cartesian coordinates of $B$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The diagram puts $B$ clockwise from $A$ in the second quadrant. Its angle is $210^\circ-75^\circ=135^\circ$ and its radius is $6$. Thus $$B=(6\cos135^\circ,6\sin135^\circ)=(-3\sqrt2,3\sqrt2).$$
